features.savedPose: Static poses, model/structure validated, localStorage library + JSON export/import; not animation-clip recording
features.stretch: Off by default for normal and free editing; explicit Action-panel switch required
features.entry: Double-click model, top Move/Rotate button, or Action panel; no persistent floating edit button

jump.policy: Own-rig rotation only; standing bilateral relaxed swing, lighter walking lead/trail arms, larger running lead/trail arms; no changes to existing leg paths, flight/root physics or UI rollback controls

standingSample.note: Paused sample of actual clip tracks, not a measurement of complete human biomechanics

jump.rollback: Maintenance-side build option MAGIUS_JUMP_STYLE=classic or revert only the motion commit before rebuilding; no player setting/button introduced

limitations: Three representative models sampled for arm geometry; four model paths tested for both walk/run landing; not every character individually certified.
Chrome real pointer/touch events, native WebGL loss and actual page reload tested; device emulation is not physical-phone hardware certification.
BFCache entry is exercised with lifecycle events; OS memory-pressure tab discard cannot be prevented by a web page.
Orientation toggle requests portrait/landscape and exits fullscreen on the second tap; actual lock support remains browser-dependent.
Free structural edits can intentionally deform a model when the user explicitly enables stretching.
Saved poses persist until site data is removed or storage is unavailable; JSON export is the durable backup.
Whole-repository audit is recorded separately after deployment; known failed files are not turned into an ignore list.
